To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the existing measures for the goldstandard based evaluation of ontology-learning systems do not meet all criteria, that we present a new measure which overcomes this problem and that we provide a list of criteria to judge future ontology-learning measures.
the evaluation of the lexical term layer can be performed with the help of existing measures, but that there is a lack of measures for the evaluation concept hierarchies.

(1) the gold standard based measures for ontology learning can be divided into measures for the evaluation on the lexical term layer and the evaluation of concept hierarchy, (2) the evaluation of concept hierarchical measures is a challenging task and (3) the new taxonomic measure presented here overcomes the problems found in existing measures.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: (1) Which criteria are relevant for the evaluation of ontology learning?
the question of what a gold standard based evaluation should look like in order to be useful.
the question how the evaluation of ontology learning can be improved.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there is still a need for a gold standard based evaluation measure for concept hierarchies.
the gold standard based measures proposed so far are not sufficient for evaluating the whole ontology learning process.
the existing measures for evaluating concept hierarchies are not sufficiently developed to allow for a reliable evaluation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the evaluation of concept hierarchy learning is still a challenging task.
the evaluation of concept hierarchy learning should be performed with the taxonomic measure presented here and the measures for the lexical term layer proposed earlier.
we present a new gold standard based measure for the evaluation of ontology learning which is able to assess the quality of concept hierarchie.
